main.description: Group-wide grants for each role, in the members space: the OAuth scopes the role holds and the roles its holders may assign. Roles compose by union; there are no deny rules.

grants.description: At most one entry per role.

grant.description: Scopes a role is granted across the group, and the roles its holders may assign.

role.description: A role id: the record key of a fyi.opensocial.role record.

scopes.description: OAuth scopes, one per item. May include permission sets. `repo:` scopes are the public-repo collections holders may write as the group.

assignable.description: Roles holders may grant or revoke, and whose holders they may eject.
